Frogs along the Mt Wilhelm elevational gradient, Papua New Guinea

Source: R/data.R
png_frogs.Rd

Real field data: 3390 frogs of 55 species recorded at eight sites from 200 to 3700 m on Mt Wilhelm, Papua New Guinea (Dahl et al. 2024). Species not formally described carry a provisional name such as "Copiula sp 1".

Usage

png_frogs

Format

A tibble with one row per site and species recorded, and seven columns:

site

Site, such as "MW0200" for 200 m.

elevation

Elevation in metres.

species

Species code.

scientific_name

Scientific or provisional name.

family

Frog family.

reproduction

Reproductive mode, "terrestrial" (direct development) or "aquatic".

abundance

Number of individuals recorded.

Source

Dahl, C., Richards, S. J., Basien, I., Mungkaje, A. J. and Novotny, V. (2023). Data from: Local and regional diversity of frog communities along an extensive rainforest elevation gradient in Papua New Guinea. Dryad. doi:10.5061/dryad.3n5tb2rqf , released under CC0 1.0. Built by data-raw/png_frogs.R.

References

Dahl, C., Richards, S. J., Basien, I., Mungkaje, A. J. and Novotny, V. (2024). Local and regional diversity of frog communities along an extensive rainforest elevation gradient in Papua New Guinea. Biotropica, 56, 90-97. doi:10.1111/btp.13283

#>  2 MW0200       200 FR23    Copiula sp 1          Microh… terrestrial         29

#>  4 MW0200       200 FR30    Mantophryne lateralis Microh… terrestrial          1
#>  5 MW0200       200 FR32    Oreophryne hypsiops   Microh… terrestrial         85
#>  6 MW0200       200 FR37    Xenorhina oxycephala  Microh… terrestrial          8
#>  7 MW0200       200 FR40    Litoria arfakiana     Pelodr… aquatic              2
#>  8 MW0200       200 FR46    Litoria mucro         Pelodr… aquatic              4
#>  9 MW0200       200 FR50    Litoria thesaurensis  Pelodr… aquatic             12
#> 10 MW0200       200 FR51    Papurana arfaki       Ranidae aquatic              9
